quarterly_data.quarter: Kingsemi results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (06-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Dong Boyu (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): new orders kept growing relatively fast in 2025, and contract liabilities at end-2025 were up more than 50% year on year, which he said partly reflects the good order momentum. The new chemical cleaning tool has been fully introduced at several leading domestic wafer fabs and won batch repeat orders from some customers; he expects chemical cleaning to keep growing well over the next few years and its share of revenue to keep rising.
